clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore’s surf-battered shore, a massive sea turtle lies beached as murlocs pick over its carcass. Viable biological samples remain among the scavenged remains, and Auberdine naturalists send them to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus for study.

Darkshore’s long coast often catches the dead and confused from the Great Sea. Ancient sea turtles drift ashore after death or beach themselves in confusion. Their carcasses quickly draw scavengers, and hostile Greymist murlocs have made crude camps around this turtle’s skeletal frame. They carve away flesh and shell, yet viable bone, shell, or tissue samples may remain intact in the wreckage.

Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is stationed in Auberdine as a field researcher, documenting unusual marine life and ecological disturbances along the coast. Night elves regard stranded beasts with reverence and scientific curiosity. Suitable remains are cataloged and prepared for shipment to scholars in Darnassus, who seek to understand why so many giants of the open sea are washing ashore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of Darkshore some time ago. It has been scavenged by the murlocs who have encamped themselves around the creature's remains. Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello friend - do you have any discoveries of creatures that have washed ashore to report on?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Another discovery for us to research - well done friend! These remains will be properly studied once they get to Darnassus. Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
